name: NOAA H11876 original side-scan mosaic near La Jolla

rights.license: CC0-1.0 (NOAA survey record; original-file terms should be reconfirmed before raw redistribution)

spatial.horizontal_crs: NAD83 / UTM zone 11N (EPSG:26911 companion projection file)

temporal.update_cadence: Historical survey; monthly original-file availability review

evidence.supports: Original NOAA survey catalog links the side-scan GeoTIFF and 2008 survey dates.
Companion projection specifies NAD83 UTM zone 11N; original bytes hash-pinned in the audit.
Companion world file specifies 1.5 m pixel dimensions despite the 1m filename.

limitations: This is a gray-scale acoustic mosaic, not a classified hard-bottom footprint or bathymetry grid; its rectangular extent includes no-data pixels.
The two USGS camera transects are a small correlated 2011 sample; local image brightness does not consistently separate rock from sand and cannot justify automatically mapped reef boundaries.
No fishing marks, ratings, bottom illustrations, drifts or exports may be derived from this lead without original substrate interpretation, current chart, MPA and legal access review.

producer.name: NOAA National Ocean Service, Office of Coast Survey

provenance.access_service: NOAA NCEI original-file archive; USGS Data Series 781 camera archive
transformations: Original compressed GeoTIFF checked at SHA-256 and opened at native 1.5 m pixels; projection/world-file sidecars inspected.
Small 24 m-radius image patches compared with 2011 camera substrate labels on two transects for exploratory source screening only.
No original image pixel, camera coordinate, target geometry or fish score is republished.
